trap.label: para + verbo
trap.wrong: I am writing for complain about my stay.
trap.right: I am writing to complain about my stay.
trap.why: Em português dizemos “escrevo para reclamar” e muitos usam for + verbo. Em inglês, a finalidade com verbo pede to + infinitivo; for só vem antes de substantivo (for a refund).

mcq.q: Which opening states the purpose of a complaint letter?
opts: I am writing to complain about the heating.
I am writing that I complain.

mcq.q: Which sentence politely **asks for** a refund?
opts: I would appreciate a full refund.
mcq.why: I would appreciate… é o pedido formal típico das provas.

mcq.q: What is the best order for the **body** of a complaint?
opts: Request, then chronological facts, then greeting
mcq.why: Fatos em ordem cronológica e depois o pedido.
Registro formal usa adjetivos como unacceptable.

fix.wrong: The heating failed and nobody repair it.
fix.right: The heating failed and nobody repaired it.

fix.wrong: I am writing for request a refund.
fix.right: I am writing to request a refund.

fix.wrong: I would appreciate to receive an apology.
fix.right: I would appreciate receiving an apology.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com I would appreciate: “I want a refund.”
Reescreva com to + infinitivo: “My purpose is the complaint about the room.” (comece com I am writing)
rewrite.answer: I am writing to complain about the room.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “The technician does not come.”
